BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Fixings and Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Fixings and Fittings.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fixings and Fittings.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fixings and Fittings.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fixings and Fittings.

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

4. When learning Introduction to Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Drawing.

   C. Skip safety briefings for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.

6. When learning Floor Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Floor Finishes.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Floor Finishes.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Floor Finishes.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Floor Finishes.

7. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

8. When learning Waste Water Disposal, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Waste Water Disposal.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Waste Water Disposal.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Waste Water Disposal.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Waste Water Disposal.

9. When learning Building Construction Project Phase 11, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Construction Project Phase 11.

10. When learning Building Material Schedules, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Material Schedules.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Material Schedules.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Material Schedules.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Building Material Schedules.

11. When learning Wall Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

12. When learning Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Building Drawing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Waste Water Disposal and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Maintenance of Plumbing Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Services and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Building Construction Project Phase 11 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

2. D — Information and Communication Technology
